latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of CamScanner image tampering detection skill.
- Detects if an image has been photoshopped, manipulated, or tampered with using CamScanner’s manipulation-detection engine.
- Returns a JSON result with `is_tampered` (boolean) and `result_text` (human-readable conclusion).
- Automatically responds to queries and trigger phrases related to image authenticity in both Chinese and English.
- Sends images to CamScanner’s official servers for real-time processing; no files are stored.
